thread:
oncall-bot: Pager: High 5xx rate and p95 latency spike for inference endpoints in us-east-1a (models: rwd-small/g5). Alert link: https://redwood.ops/alerts/IA-4321

alice: looking at logs now, starting triage.

dave: oncall here, taking. any obvious customer impact?

alice: internal metric -> ~7% request retries. SCXO reported timeouts from Prod.

maria: net team: saw a route table change on subnet us-east-1a-ephemeral-2 at 17:12 UTC, multiple ARP flaps and asymmetric pathing. could be partial route churn.

sre-rotation: confirmed: NLB target health flapping for several nodes in az1a, tcp resets visible in connection traces.

dave: mitigation plan: 1) drain affected node pool, 2) shift traffic off us-east-1a to us-east-1b/c, 3) enable lighter model variant (rwd-small-quant) as fallback. executing step 2 now.

alice: running rebalance command to shift weights away from az1a:
```bash
# control plane call - move 80% of traffic off az1a
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/route/rebalance \
  -d '{"region":"us-east-1","avoid_az":"us-east-1a","weight_shift":80}'
```

dave: executed. Control plane shows ~82% traffic rerouted off us-east-1a. p50 latency already improving.

oncall-bot: Note: autoscaler for ephemeral pool us-east-1a-ephemeral has been disabled to prevent new pods landing on degraded hosts.

maria: net suggests temporarily disassociating the problematic route table from the ephemeral subnet and re-associating after validation. this should stop route churn.

dave: coordinating with infra to drain nodes and apply route changes. @maria please confirm when route disassociation completes.

maria: running disassociate now, ETA ~90s.

alice: tagging impacted customers: SCXO, BetaApp. symptom: 504/timeouts on inference requests. recommend CS notify.

customer-success: copying standard templated notice to affected customers: "We're experiencing inference latency/errors in us-east-1a. Traffic is being rerouted; we expect degraded behavior to continue up to 30 minutes. We'll update when normal service restored." Sending now. :email:

eng-runtime: enabling KV-cache warmup on fallback variant to reduce cold-regens when traffic shifts. patching rollout to 20% fallback.

maria: route association removed. BGP/flow metrics show stabilization, packet loss dropped from 4.9% -> 0.9% over last minute.

oncall-bot: Alert update: p95 latency cleared for main endpoint. Error rate still elevated for small subset (1.2%).

dave: good progress. keep monitoring metrics and logs for any new health flaps. I'll leave this open and hand off to night oncall.

dave: Handoff: leaving with @alice for continuing monitoring. last checkpoint logs saved at ts=1719994460. please escalate if error rate rises >2% or NLB flaps resume.

alice: acknowledged, taking post-mitigation watch. I'll update runbook with route-change steps and customer notify notes. :thumbsup:
